stem: How did the loss of its control of the Mississippi River contribute to the defeat of the Confederacy?

options.label: A
options.text: The river had provided direct access to the Union's base of military operations.

options.label: B
options.text: Losing control of the river removed the physical barrier between slave and free states.

options.label: C
options.text: The river had provided the Confederacy with a power source for factories and mills.

options.label: D
options.text: Losing control of the river divided the Confederacy in two and cut off its supplies.
